subject: Post-demo compliance recap & recommended QA path
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Angela Park <angela.park@medgroup.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo compliance recap & recommended QA path

Angela —

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo this morning. Quick recap + suggested path for the security/compliance items we discussed so we keep momentum on the procurement timeline:

Key asks you raised
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and latest report date
- Confirmation on GDPR data residency options (EU hosting)
- HIPAA / PHI handling and whether we can provide a BAA
- Preferred questionnaire format (SIG, CAIQ, or your custom form)

Our recommended path
1) Start with a SIG prefilling to reduce lift for your team — we can include a CAIQ supplement if you prefer cloud-controls mapping.
2) Share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a short SOC2 summary doc for quick review.
3) Schedule a 30-minute security intake call with your SecOps to clarify hosting/dataflow and PHI boundaries.

Proposed next steps / timeline
- I’ll attach a SOC2 summary (redacted) and a draft SIG prefilling (see attachments).
- Would you be able to confirm preferred questionnaire (SIG vs CAIQ vs custom) by EOD Wednesday, Dec 7?
- If SIG is fine, we’ll prefill and return with an evidence map within 48 hours; if you want CAIQ first, we’ll do that instead.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (redacted), SIG-prefill-2026.xlsx
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/654321

If helpful I can also loop in our compliance lead (Karthik) to the intake call — he’s copied.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0136

From: Angela Park <angela.park@medgroup.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: MedGroup SecOps <secops@medgroup.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance recap & recommended QA path

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying questions from our side before we pick a questionnaire format:

1) SOC 2: Can you confirm the date range covered by the Type II report and whether you have a SOC 2 summary (controls mapped to hosting locations) we can review quickly? We don’t need the full report right away — redacted is fine.

2) PHI / HIPAA: Does Redwood process PHI on hosted (SaaS) deployments today? If yes, do you offer a standard BAA and are there any functional changes required on our side?

3) Data residency: Our security team requires EU data residency for some workloads. Can you confirm whether you support EU-hosted instances or Dedicated/Private deployments that keep data in-region? Any guides?

4) Evidence types: On the SIG/CAIQ prefilling — will you include references to evidence artifacts (logs, runbooks, config screenshots) or do you expect us to host/provide those? What’s typically included in your prefills?

5) Timeline + call: We’d like to do a quick intake call next week. Our SecOps are broadly available Wed 12/09 between 10–12 PT. Does that work?

I attached our onboarding sheet so you can see the inventory/questions we’ll likely need answered.

Attachments: MedGroup_Security_Onboarding_Sheet.xlsx

Best,
Angela Park
Head of Vendor Risk — MedGroup Health
angela.park@medgroup.com | +1 (206) 555-0124

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo compliance recap & recommended QA path

Priyom / Lauren —

Copying a short internal plan so our reply to Angela covers everything and we hit the 12/09 intake call ready. Action items below are intentionally prescriptive so we don’t go back and forth: 

Quick answers we should include in reply to Angela:
- SOC2: provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II (period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) plus a 1-page controls summary that maps hosting locations where relevant — attach as "SOC2-Redacted-2025.pdf" (we have a template in the SharePoint link below).
- PHI/HIPAA: confirm Redwood can process PHI on hosted SaaS; BAA available for enterprise customers. Note: for full PHI processing we typically recommend Dedicated or Private deployments — add a short note about our Dedicated offering and how it isolates data.
- Data residency: confirm EU hosting via Private/Dedicated (we support EU regions). Point them to our deployment options doc and say we’ll cover specifics on the call.
- SIG/CAIQ prefilling: recommend starting with SIG prefilling + CAIQ supplement. We will: prefill answers, attach evidence references (screenshot filenames / doc paths), and provide an evidence map listing the artifact owners. We do not upload customer-sensitive artifacts to external portals without explicit permission.

Who does what (owners / deadlines)
- Priyom: Email Angela today with redacted SOC2 and a prefilled SIG workbook (use the SIG-prefill-2026.xlsx template). Ask for confirmation on intake call slot Wed 12/09 10:30 PT. (Due: EOD 12/08)
- Karthik: Prepare a 1-page note on PHI handling and a short table comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private for evidence/residency (Due: morning 12/09 to join the call).
- Lauren: Create the calendar invite for 12/09 10:30 PT and include a short agenda (intake + next steps) — invite SecOps alias and Legal if needed.

Attachments to include when Priyom sends: SOC2-Redacted-2025.pdf, SIG-prefill-2026.xlsx (prefill), and reference link: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sig-prefill-templates

I’ll review the prefill before you send.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Compliance — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0173
